name: discord-codex-bridge
description: Proxy-aware Discord bridge and setup skills for Codex remote chat/control.

interface.shortDescription: Configure and operate Discord remote access for Codex.
interface.longDescription: A proxy-aware Discord bot bridge for routing paired Discord DMs and enabled guild text channels into Codex, with skills for setup, pairing, access management, and local service operation.
defaultPrompt: Use $discord-codex-bridge to install the Discord bridge.
Use $configure to set my Discord bot token and proxy.
Use $access to pair users and enable guild text channels.
